profile_text: With a focus on professional development, this organization designs and implements training programs in close collaboration with universities and companies, addressing the needs of a rapidly changing job market. Founded in 1989 as a spin-off of the Heinrich-Heine-Universität, it has established itself as a leading provider of continuing education, driving its 175% growth since the baseline. Its tailored programs have attracted a growing client base, resulting in a workforce of 165 employees in 2024.
